'''Wratchen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was on [[Voss]], seeking to acquire [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Ssorokk|cyberbeasts]] from the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jela Reneke]]. Wratchen met Reneke in the [[Lab 68]] of the [[Dark Heart]], but their meeting was interrupted by the [[Voidhound]], who killed both of them.
